body: Use case: stylized-concept. NEW original Chicory GT 2008 front-engine V6 front-drive 2+2 sports coupe eight-view game sprite sheet. Reference only worn painterly 2994 salvage style and layout, not reference car design. Distinct low wide rounded long nose, sweeping arched roof tapering to short hatch tail, single long side door plus triangular quarter window, rounded muscular rear haunches. Faded deep blue paint with mustard and pale gray riveted repair panels. Original narrow swept headlamps, divided rectangular rear lamps and modest low rear spoiler. No logos, badges, text, exact manufacturer grille or trade dress. Eight isolated matching views in 4 columns 2 rows on wide 3:1 transparent canvas: top front, front quarter nose LEFT, full side nose LEFT, rear quarter nose RIGHT; bottom rear, rear quarter nose LEFT, full side nose RIGHT, front quarter nose RIGHT. Exactly one door handle each side. No tires/rims/wheels: wheel holes genuinely transparent, open through bottom, no black backing. Runtime supplies wheels. No ground shadows or scenery. Generous clear margins, no overlap/cropping. Clean alpha edges.
dashboard: Use case: stylized-concept. NEW original Chicory GT 2008 sporting 2+2 coupe LHD dashboard overlay. Reference only worn painterly 2994 salvage material and transparent overlay structure, not same dashboard. Curving charcoal dashboard with faded deep blue surround and mustard riveted repairs. Two tall narrow center vents, small rectangular controls and three round climate knobs, low rounded passenger glovebox. Large completely BLANK opaque black instrument binnacle on LEFT approximately x220..800,y460..690 on1983x793 canvas. No painted instruments, numbers, dials or text inside, runtime draws them. No steering wheel or column, hands, logos. Entire windshield above lower-half dashboard genuinely transparent, thin posts at far edges only, no roof crossbar/scenery. Wide2.5:1 canvas, straight-on driver camera. Original fictional design, not manufacturer replica. Clean alpha edges.
bodyCorrection: Use case: precise-object-edit. Redesign the car geometry in all eight views, not just recolor: this Chicory GT must be clearly DISTINCT from the reference compact hatch. Give it a MUCH LOWER cabin, longer rounded nose, broader rear haunches, short horizontal rear deck with small low spoiler, long tapering side window ending in a small curved quarter window, and a single narrow vertical decorative vent behind each front wheel. Strong low elongated 2+2 sports-coupe silhouette. Replace front lamps with narrow curved single blades and rear lamps with two round lamps per side inside an angular housing. Keep dark blue/mustard salvage palette and painterly 2994 surface. Keep all eight view orientations and 4x2 layout exactly, same margins and transparent background. No wheels/tires: all wheel openings remain fully transparent and open through bottom, no backing. One door handle per side, no logos/text, no ground/shadows. Do not leave previous hatchback proportions.
